html:
Selling one home and
buying the next at once?
Breathe. That’s exactly
what I’m here for.
captions: Selling and buying at the same time is my favorite puzzle. You don’t have to solve it alone.
Two moves, one plan, zero panic. That’s my job. Talk soon!

html:
You don’t have to have
it all figured out.
You just need someone
who’s done this 1,200 times.
captions: 1,200 families and counting. Whatever your question is, I’ve probably heard it. Ask away!
You bring the questions. I’ll bring 23 years of answers.

html:
The next home isn’t
about more square feet.
It’s about more room
for the life you want.
captions: Moving up is really about making room for the life you want. What would you do with a little more space?
Golden hour in Carroll County never gets old. Neither does helping families find their next chapter.

html:
Some places
you move to.
Others you come home to.
Carroll County
is the second kind.
captions: Carroll County has a way of feeling like home fast. Ask me anything about making the move.
Fall nights like this are why so many families move here and never leave.

html:
Farm stands, fall Saturdays
and a backyard big enough
for every bit of it.
captions: Farm stand season is the best season. Where’s your favorite Carroll County fall stop?
Room for the pumpkins, the leaf piles and the whole crew. That’s the dream, right?

html:
Quieter streets.
Room to ride.
This is what
moving up is really for.
captions: Bikes on the trail and no rush to get home. This is what moving up is really about.
More room to ride, play and breathe. What does your family need more of in your next home?
